description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for the 'git' command, specifically testing the '--pathspec-from-file' option in 'git commit'. It defines setup procedures, test cases with various delimiters, quoting, and error conditions to validate the behavior of pathspec handling in git commits.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git HEAD to a prior checkpoint using soft reset.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies that the actual diff-tree matches the expected output after a commit.
